blocks.prompt: 9 Find the gradient and an equation of tangent line to the graph of \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\) at \(x = 9\).
blocks.explanation:
Square root ki curve par tangent line. Slope \(f'(9)\) hai.
Is dafa hum seedha point \(x = 9\) par limit lenge: \(f'(9) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\frac{f(9 + \delta x) - f(9)}{\delta x}\). Yeh bhi first principle hi hai, bas \(x\) ki jagah shuru se \(9\).
Plan: upar root aayega, is liye rationalise karenge, phir limit, phir point-slope form.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\), \(x_1 = 9\).
Find karna hai: gradient \(f'(9)\) aur tangent line.
Tareeqa: point par first principle: \(f'(9) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\frac{f(9 + \delta x) - f(9)}{\delta x}\). Root hai, is liye conjugate se rationalise karenge. Yeh Exercise 13.1 hai, is liye rule ke bajaye limit dikhana hai. Kisi point par tangent ki gradient (slope / dhalaan) \(m = f'(x_1)\) hoti hai, aur tangent line ki equation point-slope form se: \(y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)\), jahan \(y_1 = f(x_1)\). Yaani humein teen cheezen chahiye: point ka \(x\), point ka \(y\), aur slope.

\(x = 9\) par difference quotient
\[\dfrac{f(9 + \delta x) - f(9)}{\delta x} = \dfrac{\sqrt{9 + \delta x} - 3}{\delta x}\]
Kyun: \(f(9) = \sqrt{9} = 3\). Agar abhi \(\delta x = 0\) rakhein to \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai, jo koi jawab nahi; is liye pehle rationalise karna zaroori hai.

Upar ko rationalise karein
\[= \dfrac{(\sqrt{9 + \delta x} - 3)(\sqrt{9 + \delta x} + 3)}{\delta x\,(\sqrt{9 + \delta x} + 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{(9 + \delta x) - 9}{\delta x\,(\sqrt{9 + \delta x} + 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{9 + \delta x} + 3}\]
Kyun: Conjugate \(\sqrt{9 + \delta x} + 3\) se upar neeche multiply kiya. Upar \((9 + \delta x) - 9 = \delta x\) bacha jo neeche wale \(\delta x\) se cancel ho gaya.

Limit lein: gradient
\[f'(9) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{9 + \delta x} + 3}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{3 + 3} = \dfrac{1}{6}\]
Kyun: \(\delta x = 0\) rakha to neeche \(3 + 3 = 6\) bana, zero nahi, is liye limit seedha \(\frac{1}{6}\) hai.

Point aur tangent ki equation
\[(x_1, y_1) = (9, 3)\]
\[y - 3 = \dfrac{1}{6}(x - 9)\]
\[6y - 18 = x - 9\]
\[6y = x + 9\]
Kyun: Point \((9, 3)\) aur slope \(\frac{1}{6}\) ko point-slope form mein rakha, phir fraction hatane ke liye dono taraf \(6\) se multiply kiya. Jawab \(x - 6y + 9 = 0\) bhi likha ja sakta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 9:\ 6y = 18 \Rightarrow y = 3 \;\checkmark\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\sqrt{x} = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} = \dfrac{1}{6}\ \text{at}\ x = 9\]
Kyun: Line \((9, 3)\) se guzarti hai, aur general formula \(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\) (Question 1(ii) jaisa kaam) bhi \(x = 9\) par \(\frac{1}{6}\) deta hai.
